Our story

The Home Place — rooted in tradition

The story began generations ago with a two-story white farmhouse on a family farm near Wayne County’s southern edge — a sanctuary after a long day, a safe haven in summer storms. That farmhouse is where the team learned hard work, stewardship and caring for neighbours.

Today White Farmhouse Realty carries that on: residential and acreage sales, commercial real estate, farm sales and property management — people first, from first showing to long after closing.

Why choose us

A local team that knows the ground

People first, always

The team starts by getting to know you and your goals — then handles showings, documents, inspections and closing so you can focus on moving forward.

Residential, acreage and farm

From a first home in Wayne to farmland that has been in a family for generations — the team lives and works on this land.

Commercial and property management

Local businesses and rental housing, from two- to four-bedroom homes to apartments and duplexes, kept up like home.

Real photos, real detail

Every listing with a proper photo and complete facts — because a buyer should see the home before they fall for it.

Areas served

Serving northeast Nebraska

Wayne and the surrounding communities — the towns where the team lives, works and already lists homes.
